title_zh: 政策工具与企业成长阶段卡库
author: 许丙南
boundary_note: These are proposed policy and enterprise-development instruments for a bounded AI innovation belt. They are not current policy, procurement approval, funding,招商承诺, legal advice or evidence of local enterprise performance.

cards.title: 公共 AI 系统登记与反馈卡
cards.problem: A supplier and a public client need a shared plain-language record before a pilot enters a public workflow.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Every S04 or S08 pilot publishes purpose, data boundary, accountable operator, current state, non-AI equivalent and complaint route on the status board.
cards.operator: district service lead + named pilot operator
cards.stop_gate: No card or no accountable operator means no public test window.

cards.title: 算法服务采购前置记录
cards.problem: Public buyers and suppliers often discuss model capability before agreeing on purpose, limits, human review and remedy.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Before S04, S08 or S09 expands, publish a compact record covering purpose, affected service, data owner, review owner, alternatives, stop condition and redress route.
cards.operator: district procurement lead + service owner + supplier compliance lead
cards.stop_gate: Missing purpose, data owner or human review blocks procurement and public testing.

cards.title: 企业模型安全验证窗口
cards.problem: A small firm needs a bounded place to reproduce safety and explainability tests before a public workflow becomes a live deployment.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Reserve a Zhongzhi Garden S04 test window with clean test data, model card, red-team note, human takeover drill, incident log and rollback rehearsal.
cards.operator: test-room operator + district safety lead + independent evaluator
cards.stop_gate: Unknown data provenance, failed takeover or missing incident log rejects the next token.

cards.title: 多渠道产品反馈与决策回执
cards.problem: Companies and public teams need usable feedback without making an account, device or digital fluency a condition of participation.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For S05 or S08, pair the contribution wall and online ledger with staffed paper, walk-in and multilingual channels; publish which feedback changed the service or policy.
cards.operator: community curator + service owner + participating supplier
cards.stop_gate: If offline participants cannot reach the same review path, the pilot cannot claim representative feedback.

cards.title: 高校成果转化与企业服务入口
cards.problem: Research strength does not automatically create a deployable product; teams need a route through IP, user need, prototype, safety review and enterprise service.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Use the AI Origin Community as a non-exclusive S08 interface: question intake, transfer consultation, model-card clinic, pilot matching and a scale-or-retire record.
cards.operator: university transfer desk + enterprise service lead + research team
cards.stop_gate: No rights clearance, no service owner or no user need means no public pilot claim.

cards.title: 企业试点扩容或退出复盘卡
cards.problem: A pilot can survive because it is visible, not because it works; a public innovation belt needs an explicit way to stop, revise or hand over a service.
cards.jingzhang_interface: At the end of each S02/S04/S08/S09 window, compare baseline, manual alternative, public benefit, risk, maintenance burden and cost, then choose scale, revise, hold or retire.
cards.operator: review panel with service owner, supplier, residents/SMEs and safety/data reviewers
cards.stop_gate: No independent review or no documented exit decision means the pilot cannot renew its token.

cards.title: 企业服务一站式人工柜台卡
cards.problem: Small firms lose time when registration, IP, data, test access, safety review and public feedback are scattered across unconnected channels.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Use the AI Origin Community and Dazhongsi service nodes as a human-led directory and handoff point, with published process steps and no automated legal decision.
cards.operator: enterprise service lead + IP/data/safety referral roster
cards.stop_gate: If a question cannot be routed to a named human owner, the AI assistant must not invent an answer.

cards.title: 研究—企业—公共服务人才轮岗卡
cards.problem: Research, product, operations and public-service teams often use different definitions of success, slowing transfer and leaving safety work unowned.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Create short, bounded S04/S08 rotations with a named learning question, confidentiality boundary, public-interest review, contribution record and return-to-role plan.
cards.operator: university transfer desk + enterprise service lead + participating employer
cards.stop_gate: No supervisor, rights boundary or return plan means no public-facing rotation.

cards.title: 一线运营者 AI 安全与企业服务培训卡
cards.problem: A public AI service fails at the handoff when counter staff, maintenance workers and safety operators cannot understand its limits or take over.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Before S02/S04/S08/S09 launch, train operators on model/data boundary, accessible service, incident response, manual fallback, complaint routing and shutdown.
cards.operator: service owner + safety/data trainer + supplier support lead
cards.stop_gate: Expired training or failed takeover drill suspends the service token.

cards.title: 共享算力与低碳服务准入
cards.problem: Small firms may need compute access, but hidden energy, queue, security and maintenance costs can make a prototype impossible to operate responsibly.
cards.jingzhang_interface: At the Zhongzhi Garden test room, publish queue rules, workload boundary, energy state, offline fallback, security owner, service window and lifecycle cost note.
cards.operator: compute service operator + energy lead + test-room safety lead
cards.stop_gate: No accountable operator or no safe fallback means the service remains a closed lab capability.

cards.title: 企业试点资金里程碑卡
cards.problem: Funding a public-facing AI pilot by spend or publicity alone rewards activity rather than a safe, useful and maintainable service.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Release any proposed support in evidence milestones: problem confirmation, rights clearance, safety gate, user test, service outcome, lifecycle cost and scale-or-retire review.
cards.operator: program manager + finance reviewer + accountable service owner
cards.stop_gate: No evidence or unresolved safety/rights issue freezes the next tranche and keeps manual service in place.

cards.title: AI 服务事故披露与修复卡
cards.problem: A pilot can fail through bad data, model drift, operator error or unsafe integration; silent correction destroys public trust and supplier learning.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For every S04, S08 or S09 window, record incident time, affected service, immediate fallback, accountable reviewer, correction, user notice and re-entry evidence.
cards.operator: service owner + supplier incident lead + public information contact
cards.stop_gate: Unreported material incident or repeated unexplained failure suspends the supplier's next window.

cards.title: 人工等价服务与响应时限卡
cards.problem: An AI feature is not a public service if people cannot reach a person when it is unavailable, wrong, inaccessible or inappropriate.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Every S07, S08 or S09 card declares the physical/phone route, response time, correction owner, outage notice and data retention of the non-AI equivalent.
cards.operator: service owner + community counter operator + supplier support lead
cards.stop_gate: A missing or slower-than-declared manual route pauses the AI feature without penalising the user.

cards.title: 企业供应商安全基线卡
cards.problem: A public pilot exposes interfaces, accounts and operational context; a promising model cannot substitute for access control, logging and patch ownership.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Before S04 or S09 access, require least privilege, credential rotation, audit logs, dependency inventory, vulnerability contact and an offline shutdown procedure.
cards.operator: information-security lead + test-room operator + supplier security contact
cards.stop_gate: Unknown privileged access or no shutdown owner blocks the token even if model metrics pass.

cards.title: 企业服务申诉与纠错卡
cards.problem: A company and a resident need a clear way to challenge an AI-assisted answer without needing to understand the model or accept an automated decision.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For S08/S09, show the source of each material answer, human decision owner, correction route, expected response time and record-retention boundary.
cards.operator: enterprise service lead + legal/rights reviewer + human counter
cards.stop_gate: Untraceable material answer or no human correction route forces immediate manual handling.

cards.title: 企业试点责任与保险前置卡
cards.problem: A public-space trial can create safety, property or service harm; naming a model is not the same as naming who responds and pays for correction.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Before S02 or S04, record operator, accountable party, emergency contact, maintenance duty, incident escalation, insurance/compensation assumption and withdrawal authority.
cards.operator: district safety lead + site operator + supplier accountable executive
cards.stop_gate: Unclear responsibility or unavailable emergency contact blocks public operation.

cards.title: 结果导向的公共 AI 采购闸门
cards.problem: A successful demonstration is not enough to justify scale; buyers need observable service outcomes, cost boundaries and an exit path.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For S08 or S09, define outcome, baseline, manual comparator, ownership, data retention, service level, total lifecycle cost and scale-or-retire decision before a second window.
cards.operator: district procurement lead + accountable service owner + finance reviewer
cards.stop_gate: No measurable public outcome or no manual comparator means no scale procurement.

cards.title: 公开问题清单与初创挑战赛卡
cards.problem: Startups need a real service problem and a bounded data boundary, while public teams need to avoid buying a solution before defining the problem.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Publish quarterly S08/S09 challenge briefs with user, service failure, non-AI baseline, allowed data, review owner, test window and no-go claims.
cards.operator: enterprise service lead + university/community problem owner
cards.stop_gate: No named problem owner or no non-AI baseline means the challenge is research only, not a procurement lead.

cards.title: 企业测试数据清洁室准入
cards.problem: A promising company may need representative data, but direct access can expose personal information, confidential operations or unreviewed third-party rights.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For S04 or S09, provide only cleared, minimised and time-bounded data inside a monitored sandbox; export only aggregate test results and an audit summary.
cards.operator: data governance lead + rights reviewer + test-room operator
cards.stop_gate: Unknown provenance, unbounded retention or unauthorised export immediately closes the test window.

cards.title: 知识产权与贡献署名闸门
cards.problem: Open collaboration can accelerate a prototype but can also create disputes over data, code, model weights, public display and commercial reuse.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Before S05 or S08 public release, attach a rights ledger naming input license, contributor, display permission, commercial boundary, takedown route and future owner.
cards.operator: community curator + legal/IP reviewer + participating company
cards.stop_gate: Unclear ownership or incompatible license keeps the artifact private and out of the public showcase.

cards.title: 政策影响评估与退出闸门
cards.problem: A company can pass a technical test while the proposed service still shifts access, workload or risk onto residents and frontline staff.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Before any S02, S08 or S09 test window, publish the affected groups, service baseline, human workload change, plausible failure modes, manual route and a scale-or-retire decision owner.
cards.operator: service owner + community reviewer + enterprise accountable executive
cards.stop_gate: Unknown affected groups, unpriced human workload or no withdrawal owner keeps the proposal in research status.

cards.title: 供应商中立的市场摸底卡
cards.problem: A public team may write a solution-shaped brief that excludes capable smaller suppliers before the service problem and acceptance test are understood.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For S08/S09 challenge briefs, publish the problem, non-AI baseline, data boundary and acceptance test first; record questions from multiple suppliers without giving any bidder privileged access.
cards.operator: procurement lead + service owner + independent market-sounding moderator
cards.stop_gate: A solution-named brief, undisclosed privileged information or a missing baseline pauses the market sounding.

cards.title: 互操作与数据可携带闸门
cards.problem: A successful pilot can become a lock-in if data, evaluation results and service workflows cannot move to another supplier or a manual route.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Before a second S08/S09 window, require exportable records, documented interfaces, human-readable formats, replacement drill and a public-service continuity plan.
cards.operator: enterprise architecture lead + service owner + procurement reviewer
cards.stop_gate: Non-exportable material records or a failed replacement drill blocks scale-up.

cards.title: 可复现评测与结果发布卡
cards.problem: A startup needs credible evidence for customers, while a public reviewer needs to distinguish a repeatable test from a selective demonstration.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For S04 or S08, publish the test question, version, data provenance, evaluation protocol, exclusions, reviewer identity, result range and failed cases without exposing protected data.
cards.operator: evaluation lead + independent reviewer + participating company
cards.stop_gate: Unknown version, undisclosed exclusions or no independent reproduction keeps the result private and non-procurement.

cards.title: 无障碍与包容性服务验收卡
cards.problem: A product may improve an average journey while making the route harder for disabled residents, older people, carers or people without accounts.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Before S02, S08 or S09 use, pair AI-assisted and ordinary routes; test step-free access, plain-language communication, staffed help, complaint correction and opt-out with affected users.
cards.operator: accessibility lead + service owner + paid community reviewers
cards.stop_gate: A blocked accessible route, app-only service or uncorrected group-specific failure stops the window.

cards.title: 算力与资源预算闸门
cards.problem: Early-stage teams can demonstrate a model by shifting energy, cost, queue time or maintenance burdens to a public host without making those burdens visible.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For S04/S05, record compute class, energy and cooling assumption, queue entitlement, cost band, lower-resource alternative and a stop threshold before a booked test window.
cards.operator: shared-compute operator + finance reviewer + participating company
cards.stop_gate: Unbounded resource use, hidden cost transfer or no lower-resource route turns the request into research-only status.

cards.title: 模型更新与变更通知闸门
cards.problem: A service can change model version, data source or fallback behaviour after approval, making an earlier safety and procurement record misleading.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For S04/S08/S09, require a versioned change note, affected functions, regression test, human-review impact, user notice, rollback package and re-approval threshold.
cards.operator: service owner + model risk reviewer + supplier release manager
cards.stop_gate: Unreviewed material change, missing rollback or silent loss of human fallback pauses service and returns to the prior version or manual route.

cards.title: 第三方依赖与供应链可见卡
cards.problem: A small supplier may rely on hosted models, datasets, libraries or subcontractors whose rights, security and continuity are invisible to the public buyer.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Before S04/S08 qualification, record material third parties, data and model provenance, service dependency, update authority, outage route, licence boundary and notification duty.
cards.operator: supplier security lead + procurement reviewer + rights reviewer
cards.stop_gate: Unknown material dependency, incompatible rights or no outage route blocks the supplier from a public test window.

cards.title: 里程碑付款与证据交付卡
cards.problem: Paying for activity or a demo can reward volume while leaving the public team without safety records, service outcomes or a usable exit.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For an S04/S08 pilot, split any future commercial decision into evidence milestones: setup and rights check, staffed test, independent review, public-service handover and scale-or-retire decision.
cards.operator: finance lead + procurement lead + service owner
cards.stop_gate: A missed safety, rights or handover milestone freezes the next payment and keeps the service on the manual route.

cards.title: 研究成果转企业的权利选项卡
cards.problem: University or community research can stall at the handoff because publication, licensing, maintenance, student contribution and public-interest rights were never separated.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For S05 or S08 transfer windows, record contributor attribution, publication timing, licence option, maintenance owner, public-use boundary, commercial route and withdrawal procedure before a company receives a test slot.
cards.operator: technology-transfer lead + researcher/community contributor + company rights lead
cards.stop_gate: Unresolved contributor rights, no maintenance owner or no public-interest boundary keeps the work in an open research room.

cards.title: 公共价值回流与收益边界卡
cards.problem: An enterprise can learn from a public test and capture private value without returning evidence, service improvements or a clear boundary on public data use.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Before S08/S09 expansion, publish what the company receives, what the public receives, which data remain excluded, how corrections return to the service and whether the window is still non-commercial.
cards.operator: service owner + enterprise accountable executive + community reviewer
cards.stop_gate: Unstated commercial reuse, no public improvement or an unbounded data claim prevents expansion.

cards.title: 安全漏洞披露与修复 SLA 卡
cards.problem: A supplier may discover a security weakness after a pilot while the public operator lacks a disclosure channel, patch deadline or safe temporary mode.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For S04/S08/S09, name a vulnerability contact, severity rubric, disclosure route, patch target, temporary manual mode and evidence that the fix did not break the earlier acceptance test.
cards.operator: supplier security lead + district security reviewer + service owner
cards.stop_gate: No disclosure route, overdue critical patch or failed regression test suspends the service.

cards.title: 退出托管与供应商替换卡
cards.problem: A public service can be technically portable yet still fail when a supplier exits because configuration, credentials, runbooks and trained operators are unavailable.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Before S08/S09 scale-up, define a bounded transition package: configuration export, data handover, runbook, contact list, training record, manual continuation and a tabletop supplier-exit drill.
cards.operator: service continuity owner + procurement lead + incumbent and replacement suppliers
cards.stop_gate: Missing handover material, no trained successor or failed exit drill blocks renewal or expansion.

cards.title: 评测异议与结果复核卡
cards.problem: A supplier or affected group may dispute an evaluation result, but without a fixed challenge route the public team may either ignore a real error or reopen the test without discipline.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For S04/S08, publish the evaluation scope, evidence-retention period, challenge window, independent reviewer, correction notice and rule for rerunning only the disputed component.
cards.operator: evaluation steward + independent reviewer + affected supplier or community representative
cards.stop_gate: Missing retained evidence, undisclosed rerun scope or an unresolved material challenge keeps the result from procurement use.

cards.title: 岗位重设计与工作质量闸门
cards.problem: Automation can raise throughput while increasing hidden checking, emotional labour or precarious work for frontline staff.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Before S08/S09 expansion, compare task allocation before and after assistance, record training time, discretion, escalation load, break quality and a worker-led stop or redesign route.
cards.operator: workforce lead + frontline worker panel + service owner
cards.stop_gate: Higher unrecognised checking load, lost escalation authority or no worker feedback route triggers redesign before expansion.

cards.title: 本地维护与备件可得性卡
cards.problem: A public-facing device or robot may work in a demonstration but fail because service staff, spare parts and safe shutdown procedures are not locally available.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Before S02/S03 deployment, record maintenance owner, inspection frequency, spare-part lead time, safe storage, accessible route impact, shutdown drill and return-to-normal responsibility.
cards.operator: site operations lead + supplier maintenance owner + accessibility reviewer
cards.stop_gate: No local maintainer, inaccessible service route or overdue inspection closes the physical test window.

cards.title: 采购评审利益冲突披露卡
cards.problem: A promising supplier can be favoured or unfairly excluded when evaluators, advisers, funders or data owners have undisclosed ties.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For any future S04/S08 procurement decision, publish evaluator roles, conflict declarations, scoring rubric, recusal rule, evidence access log and a supplier-neutral correction route.
cards.operator: procurement integrity officer + evaluation chair + independent observer
cards.stop_gate: Undeclared material conflict, unequal evidence access or a missing recusal decision invalidates the evaluation round.

cards.title: 留存期限与删除验证卡
cards.problem: A test can be described as time-bounded while logs, prompts, images or derived records remain in backups and supplier systems without a verified deletion path.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For S04/S08/S09, classify records, set minimum and maximum retention, assign deletion authority, test backup expiry and issue a deletion receipt without collecting extra personal data.
cards.operator: data governance lead + supplier data steward + rights reviewer
cards.stop_gate: Unknown retention, untested backups or no deletion authority blocks the next test window.

cards.title: 环境资源外部性与扩容闸门
cards.problem: Enterprise growth can hide water, energy, heat, noise, waste or maintenance burdens that a public host must absorb.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Before scaling S04/S05/S09, publish a relative resource ledger, local operating assumptions, lower-resource alternative, affected maintenance team and a threshold that triggers redesign or retirement.
cards.operator: sustainability lead + facilities operator + enterprise accountable executive
cards.stop_gate: Unpriced material burden, no lower-resource route or threshold breach prevents scale-up.

cards.title: 共享算力公平排队卡
cards.problem: A shared test facility can be captured by well-funded teams, leaving small companies, public-interest researchers and community problems without a credible validation slot.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For S04/S05 bookings, publish eligibility, queue position, time cap, public-interest reservation, conflict rule, appeal path and a lower-resource option; record actual wait and access by group.
cards.operator: shared-compute operator + access committee + community problem owner
cards.stop_gate: Opaque queue priority, repeated overrun or no appeal path freezes new privileged bookings.

cards.title: 标准贡献与互认记录卡
cards.problem: A company may claim standards leadership without showing which test, public problem or reusable artefact the contribution actually improves.
cards.jingzhang_interface: For S04/S05/S08 outputs, record the problem addressed, versioned test evidence, contributor rights, proposed change, review status, reuse conditions and what remains a local concept.
cards.operator: standards-workshop lead + rights reviewer + participating company
cards.stop_gate: No reproducible evidence, unclear rights or a claim of endorsement without review keeps the contribution unpublished.

cards.title: 跨场景复制前置审查卡
cards.problem: A result from one site, population or service can be copied to another context even though the data, route, operator, risks and non-AI baseline have changed.
cards.jingzhang_interface: Before moving an accepted S02/S08/S09 result between Zhongzhi Garden, Origin and Dazhongsi, compare context, affected groups, operating owner, legal review, baseline, failure modes and a fresh stop drill.
cards.operator: scale decision chair + destination service owner + independent reviewer
cards.stop_gate: Changed context without a new baseline or failed destination stop drill means no replication.
